high_level_description: This black-and-white photograph captures a serene beach scene. The subject is a person standing on the sandy shore, facing away from the camera but looking over their shoulder towards it. They are wearing a dark t-shirt with a graphic design on the front, shorts, and sandals. Their hair appears to be slightly tousled, and they have a beard. The background features the ocean with gentle waves rolling onto the shore. The sky above is partly cloudy, with some areas of the clouds appearing darker, suggesting either early morning or late afternoon light.
